messages:
raj: Heads-up — after the driver+kernel roll last night we saw a small XID spike in eu-west GPU pool. Hypothesis: a subset of nodes ended up with mismatched kernel module signatures which may correlate with KV cache invalidation -> XIDs. I want to add a checksum/signature correlation probe into the upgrade smoke harness. TL;DR: sample module checksums pre/post, correlate to XID per-host over a 30m window.

eng-sre-bot: deploy-bot started canary roll on eu-west-1-gpu-pool (canary=5 nodes) at 03:14 UTC :rocket:

maria: Can you paste the exact commands you want the harness to run? I can add them to the canary job.

raj: Sure — rough sketch (we'll use the agent instead of SSH in prod):

```
# capture module checksums (example)
find /lib/modules -type f -name "nv*.ko" -exec sha256sum {} \; | sort > /tmp/pre_checksums.txt
# after upgrade:
find /lib/modules -type f -name "nv*.ko" -exec sha256sum {} \; | sort > /tmp/post_checksums.txt
# get xid hosts (example from event log):
jq -r '.events[] | select(.type=="XID") | .host' /var/log/gpu/events.json | sort | uniq -c
```

Note: harness should tag host IDs, driver module version, and `modinfo` signed-by field.

tina: We should avoid SSHing all nodes during canary. Use the agent collect (1% sample) and fall back to full capture only if XIDs spike. Sampling should catch regressions without load.

alex: For gating: if XID rate increases by >50% vs baseline on canary AND hosts with checksum mismatch account for >=60% of those XIDs then auto-drain the canary and rollback. Sound reasonable?

raj: Yep. More concretely: gate = (canary_xid_count_30m >= 3) AND (mismatch_xid_fraction >= 0.6). For dedicated pools we keep manual confirmation but send an urgent page. Also capture ECC counters.

sam: I'll wire the console alert. Use metric name `gpu.xid.count` and a derived metric `gpu.xid.by_host` for correlation. What alert channel? #eng-oncall?

eng-sre-bot: monitoring: created alert `canary-gpu-checksum-xid-correlation` -> notify #eng-oncall and #eng-infra :bell:

maria: Also capture `dmesg` tail (last 200 lines) and `nvidia-smi -q` around the time window. ECC rising often precedes XIDs, so include `gpu.ecc.corrected` and `gpu.ecc.uncorrected`.

tina: I'll run a dry run in staging tomorrow at 09:00 PT and post results. Volunteers to review logs: @maria @sam @alex?

maria: +1 :thumbsup:

alex: One more ask — log `modinfo <module>` output (version, signer) and the kernel release (`uname -r`). If we see mismatches between `uname -r` and installed module target, that's a red flag.

raj: Good call. I'll update the harness with: sample agent collector command, pre/post checksum diffs, `modinfo` output, `nvidia-smi -q` snapshot, and tie to `gpu.xid.by_host` for 30m windows. Plan: run for next canary and produce a dashboard with per-host correlation.

sam: I'll add the dashboard panel and a short playbook snippet for oncall (drain -> rollback -> tag owners).

raj: Thanks — if the staging dry run looks clean we'll roll this into the canary template. Will post results here after the run.
